title_zh: 雅思小作文（Task 1）动态多折线图满分范文：四国清洁能源与煤炭发电占比 25 年演进及主次反转

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 图表小作文首段：题目改写与总体趋势概览（Paraphrase + Macro Overview）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 或数据报告的第一段：用同义句法改写图表标题，并用两句话高度凝练全图最核心的 2 个宏观趋势（极值、反超拐点或主次格局），绝不堆砌零碎数字。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Paraphrase -> Overall Trajectory Contrast -> Dominant Crossover/Extremum (Zero raw numbers in Overview!). 绑定逻辑规则：L013, L015.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: The line graph compares the proportion of electricity generated from four fuel sources across three industrial economies between 2000 and 2025. Overall, renewable sources—particularly solar and wind power—followed a pronounced upward trajectory over the 25-year span, whereas coal reliance contracted steadily. Most notably, clean energy generation overtook fossil-fuel consumption around 2018, shifting from a marginal supplement to the dominant power supply by the end of the period.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 动态时间序列趋势分段描述（暴涨、缓降、平台期与拐点）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写动态折线图（或模型训练收敛曲线）的主体细节段：把一条经历“初期缓慢爬升 -> 中期爆发增长 -> 后期高位平台期”的曲线，以及另一条“冲高回落”的曲线对比写活。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Initial Disparity -> Multi-Phase Surge & Plateau (Entity A) -> Peak-then-Decline (Entity B) -> Gap Reversal. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L013.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: In 2000, battery-electric vehicles accounted for a mere 4% of municipal fleet purchases, trailing diesel buses at 62%. Following five years of marginal fluctuation, electric adoption accelerated sharply after 2006, quadrupling to 38% by 2018 before leveling off at approximately 41% through 2025. By contrast, diesel procurement peaked briefly at 67% in 2004 but subsequently underwent a sustained contraction, plunging to 19% by the end of the survey. This divergent trajectory reversed the initial 58-percentage-point deficit into a more than twofold lead for electric fleets.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 异常数据点（Outliers）与局部背离现象精准批注段（Outlier & Anomaly Annotation）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想在图表或实验结果段中，专门挑出违背总体规律的 1–2 个异常点（Outliers）或局部反常尖峰进行精准描述与成因剖析。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: General Rule vs. Notable Departure -> Quantitative Deviation -> Root Cause Attribution -> Calibration Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L013.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Although deep spectral transformers outperform linear baselines across six of the seven benchmarks, a notable departure emerges on the financial Exchange-Rate dataset. Whereas complex attention models reduce MSE by 12%–18% on periodic energy and weather streams, they trail a single-layer DLinear baseline by 4.3% on Exchange-Rate. Autocorrelation analysis reveals that this reversal stems from the near-martingale nature of daily currency returns, where weak seasonal periodicity causes high-capacity attention layers to overfit transient market shocks. This anomaly confirms that model capacity must be matched to the intrinsic signal-to-noise ratio of the underlying stochastic process.
